summary: Qwen3.5 MTP now disables compressed-tensors quantization when the checkpoint ignore list contains mtp.* entries, preventing fused qkv_proj and gate_up_proj parameters from being allocated in packed form for plain BF16 MTP weights. The regression failed before the source change and passes after it, with independent target-only, empty, missing, and non-string ignore-list boundaries.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before regression: _mtp_quant_config returned the reported compressed_tensors config unchanged despite mtp.* ignore entries. Raw JUnit: reports/j-1cee264fc652/qwen3_5_mtp-before.xml

Passing-after regression and boundary cases for reported mtp.* entries, unrelated target entries, empty/missing ignore lists, and non-string entries. Raw JUnit: reports/j-1cee264fc652/qwen3_5_mtp-after.xml

Broader fusion-gate suite: 33 passed and one unrelated existing test named test_expert_parallelism_blocks_fusion_off_rocm failed because the prepared host is ROCm. Raw JUnit: reports/j-1cee264fc652/shared_experts_fusion_gates.xml
Changed production and regression-test Python files compile successfully.
Environment limitation: the prepared interpreter does not contain the ruff module, so lint could not run.

gpu_execution.evidence: rocm-smi identified the assigned GPU as AMD Instinct MI355X, gfx950, but no Qwen3.5 compressed-tensors checkpoint weights were available. The corrected behavior is a constructor/configuration decision and was validated deterministically without claiming model acceptance or numerical GPU execution.

remaining_limitations: The reported 27B compressed-tensors Qwen3.5 checkpoint and its weights were unavailable, so full server startup, skipped-weight log counts, speculative accept length, throughput, and semantic accuracy were not reproduced.
Only one gfx950 GPU was assigned; the report used two RTX 3090 GPUs with TP=2, so no multi-GPU or NVIDIA-specific qualification was attempted.
The broader fusion-gate file has one unrelated ROCm/platform expectation failure; the focused changed behavior passes.
Ruff is absent from the prepared Python environment.
